items.title: Jerry Hey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 2, 2023
items.q: I don’t know whether I would take Kevin Durant over Larry Bird... As Larry Bird did.

ctx.x: Every once in a while I’ll get on YouTube or whatever and, you know, watch Larry’s greatest ten whatever.
I’ve watched that recently. It’s just incredible. But then somebody had the other day they had Durant versus Bird in the stats and all that. Kevin Durant would kill Larry Bird in stats.
